mandatory_defects.finding: Large inflated cream trays, raised borders/drop shadows, a thick pill selection marker and the deeply beveled Build button retain a conventional older mobile-game treatment rather than the requested deliberate modern UI.
mandatory_defects.repair: Preserve the excellent world composition and exact labels. Flatten and sharpen UI surfaces, soften their edge/shadow treatment, slim the navigation indicator, and use a compact flat orange cut-corner primary action.
